final.name: Multiplicity Modeling
final.audit_justification: Concerns a substantive modeling choice (whether inherent ambiguity is respected or collapsed), not a surface or production marker.

final.name: Structure-Aligned Inductive Bias
final.audit_justification: Asks whether architectural structure is genuinely tied to and empirically examined against the task, a substantive design-and-evidence question.

final.name: Canonical Ecosystem Naming
final.audit_justification: Counts surface namedropping of standard entities rather than evaluating the work, though genuine use of canonical benchmarks can also reflect real methodological rigor.

final.name: Headline claim survives the abstract's own qualifiers
final.audit_justification: Checks whether the paper's central claim is honestly supported by its own reported detail, a substantive claim-integrity question.

final.name: Artifact-release signaling
final.audit_justification: Explicitly scores only presence of release language, not the artifacts' reality or usefulness, though well-resourced or careful teams that release artifacts may also do better work.

final.name: Trend-Aligned Vocabulary
final.audit_justification: Explicitly a fashionable-vocabulary marker that disclaims topic importance, i.e. a pure trend-chasing fingerprint.

final.name: Superlative Claim Rhetoric
final.audit_justification: Explicitly rhetorical frequency of hype language, disclaiming truth or quality of the underlying claims.

final.name: Theory is load-bearing: the derivation licenses the method
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether a proof or derivation actually determines the proposed procedure, a substantive theory-method coupling question.

final.name: Theory-to-Algorithm Closure
final.audit_justification: Same substantive question as X09: whether theoretical analysis actually determines the implementable construction.

final.name: Economy of exposition (information per sentence)
final.audit_justification: Measures whether sentences carry genuine non-redundant content rather than raw length, a content/craft property distinct from mere verbosity.

final.name: Sheer expository volume of the abstract body
final.audit_justification: Explicitly measures quantity of text only and disclaims any quality judgment, though a longer abstract sometimes reflects genuinely more elaborated work.

final.name: Explicit code/artifact release mention
final.audit_justification: Scores only the presence of an explicit release statement, not the work's substance, though it may track genuinely more rigorous or open producers.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction scores only whether a release sentence or link appears in the abstract, not whether any artifact exists, works, or supports the claims, so a 10 is awarded for a piece of boilerplate a judge can detect without reading the science. Routed B, but mixed because open-release practice plausibly co-occurs with more rigorous and better-resourced work.

final.name: Challenges a widely-held assumption or standard practice
final.audit_justification: Assesses a substantive intellectual contribution: whether the work overturns received wisdom or standard practice.

final.name: Density of specific quantified result figures
final.audit_justification: Scores raw density of numerals while explicitly disclaiming correctness or fair comparison, though it may track genuinely more thorough empirical reporting.

final.name: Extent of adversarial/security-threat subject framing
final.audit_justification: Explicitly a subject-matter/topic marker with an instruction not to judge whether the topic is important.

final.name: Single-idea compressibility (elegance)
final.audit_justification: Assesses the substantive conceptual simplicity of the actual contribution, not surface presentation.

final.name: Density of formal mathematical/symbolic notation
final.audit_justification: Scores surface notation density while disclaiming correctness or rigor, though heavier notation may stem from genuinely more rigorous theoretical work.

final.name: Publication-Polish Fluency
final.audit_justification: Explicitly surface editing quality rather than research quality, though polish may track well-resourced producers who also do better work.

final.name: Concrete numeric result density
final.audit_justification: Same numeral-density surface measure as X15, disclaiming how positive or well-supported the results are.
final.arbiter_reason: The text explicitly brackets out how positive or well-supported the figures are, reducing the criterion to counting numerals and units, so an abstract padded with unsupported or trivial numbers outscores one with a single decisive result. Routed B, but mixed because genuinely careful empirical work tends to report checkable quantities.

final.name: Boundary and Failure Characterization
final.audit_justification: Substantive characterization of when a method helps, fails, or changes behavior, with explicit assumptions.

final.name: Resource Accounting
final.audit_justification: Substantive engineering rigor: whether quantified resource constraints are actually handled by the core design.

final.name: Explicit first-to-achieve priority claims
final.audit_justification: Explicitly a rhetorical priority-claim marker that disclaims whether the claim is actually true.

final.name: Explanatory Insight Beyond Performance
final.audit_justification: Substantive conceptual explanation or diagnostic value beyond raw performance numbers.

final.name: Rhetorical framing as adjudicating a field debate
final.audit_justification: Scores presence of a rhetorical framing device (posed question or stated tension) rather than genuine engagement with or resolution of a debate, though real engagement with field tensions can be the upstream cause.
final.arbiter_reason: It scores the presence of a rhetorical opening device -- a posed question or a 'prior work suggests X, but...' construction -- and explicitly contrasts it with plainly stated contributions, so it rewards packaging rather than any actual resolution of a field tension. Routed B, but mixed because real engagement with an open question is one plausible upstream cause of that framing.

final.name: Positions against a named strongest prior with a stated inability
final.audit_justification: Rewards specific, checkable engagement with a named strongest prior over vague 'existing approaches' language, a substantive scholarly-rigor signal.
